extDescription.message: Send downloads from your browser to your DownloadPulse server.
extDescription.description: Store and manifest description of the extension.

popupNotConnected.description: Toolbar popup: the extension is not connected to a DownloadPulse server.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the extension's settings page.

popupConnect.description: Popup button: start connecting this browser.

popupProbing.description: Popup status while checking this computer or the server.

popupNotFound.message: No DownloadPulse is running on this computer. Start it and check again, or connect to a server.
popupNotFound.description: Popup: nothing answered on this computer.

popupCheckAgain.description: Popup button: look on this computer again.

popupServerLabel.description: Popup: label of the server address field.

popupServerPlaceholder.description: Popup: example in the server address field.

popupConnectServer.description: Popup button: connect to the address entered.

popupWaiting.message: In the DownloadPulse tab that just opened, choose Connect to add this browser.
popupWaiting.description: Popup status while waiting for the person to approve on the server. 'Connect' is DownloadPulse's own button (DebridPulse key browser.pairing.approve): use that catalog's exact word.

popupCode.description: Popup: precedes the pairing code shown on both sides.

popupCodeHint.message: DownloadPulse shows the same code. Only choose Connect if they match.
popupCodeHint.description: Popup: under the code. CRITICAL (anti-phishing). 'Connect' is DownloadPulse's own button in its Connect a browser dialog (DebridPulse key browser.pairing.approve): use that catalog's exact word.

popupStartAgain.description: Popup button: back to the start after a failure.

popupConnected.description: Popup status: this browser is connected.

popupServer.description: Popup: label of the connected server's address.

popupAccount.description: Popup: label of the account this browser belongs to.

popupBrowser.description: Popup: label of the name this browser was given.

failureUnreachable.message: That server can't be reached. Check the address and that DownloadPulse is running.

failureCertificate.message: That server can't be reached securely. If it uses its own certificate, open it in a tab, accept the certificate, then connect again.
failureCertificate.description: Popup error: an HTTPS server failed, possibly a self-signed certificate.

failureNotDownloadPulse.message: Something answered at that address, but it isn't DownloadPulse.

failureTooOld.message: This DownloadPulse is too old to connect browsers. Update it, then connect again.
failureTooOld.description: Popup error: the server lacks the browser protocol.

failureDenied.message: The connection was denied in DownloadPulse.

failureExpired.message: The connection request expired. Start again.

failurePermission.message: The browser didn't allow access to that server.
failurePermission.description: Popup error: the person declined the site access prompt.

failureUnauthorized.message: DownloadPulse no longer accepts this browser. Connect it again.
failureUnauthorized.description: Popup error: the token was refused.

failureFailed.message: Something went wrong while connecting. Start again.

pairingClientName.description: The name a browser connection is given by default, for example 'Firefox on Linux'. The person can change it when approving.

menuSend.description: Right-click menu item on links and selected text.

hoverSend.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the small button beside a download link.

videoSend.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button on a video player.

pageActionSend.description: Tooltip of the icon in Firefox's address bar on pages with a video.

sendDone.description: Toast after a download was sent.

sendNotConnected.message: This browser isn't connected to DownloadPulse. Connect it from the toolbar button.

sendNothingFound.message: No link was found in the selected text.
sendNothingFound.description: Toast after sending a selection without URLs.

sendLocalNetwork.message: That link is on your local network. DownloadPulse's Local Network settings don't allow it from a browser; add it with Quick Add instead.

sendCollectionItem.message: That link points to one item in a collection. Add it with Quick Add in DownloadPulse to choose the item or the whole collection.

sendTooMany.message: This browser has too many unfinished downloads in DownloadPulse. Try again when some have finished.

sendTooLarge.message: That file is larger than DownloadPulse accepts.

sendInvalid.description: Toast: the source was refused as invalid or unsupported.

sendUnavailable.message: DownloadPulse couldn't reach that source right now. Try again later.

sendNoSiteAccess.message: The browser no longer allows DownloadPulse to read that site. Allow site access for DownloadPulse in the browser's extension settings.

sendCaptureFailed.message: That file couldn't be fetched from the site.

sendCaptureWebPage.message: That site returned a web page instead of the file. You may need to sign in to it first.
sendCaptureWebPage.description: Toast: capture got HTML (often a sign-in page).

listTitle.description: Popup: the title of the list of downloads this browser sent (a section title, with its colon; follow your language's own conventions for a title and a colon).

listEmpty.message: Nothing sent from this browser yet.

jobQueued.description: A download's state: accepted or queued.

jobWorking.description: A download's state: being resolved or finalized.

jobPausedHere.description: A download's state: this browser paused it.

jobPausedServer.description: A download's state: paused by someone in DownloadPulse, or everything is paused.

jobNeedsAttention.description: A download's state: DownloadPulse needs the person's input.

jobRemoved.description: A download's state: this browser withdrew it.

jobResume.description: Button on a download this browser paused.

jobRemove.description: Button on a download: withdraw this browser's request.

controlSharedInterest.message: Other requests need this download, so it can't be paused from here.
controlSharedInterest.description: Beneath a download after a declined pause.

controlGloballyPaused.message: Everything is paused in DownloadPulse right now.
controlGloballyPaused.description: Beneath a download after a declined control.

controlPausedElsewhere.message: This download was paused in DownloadPulse; resume it there.
controlPausedElsewhere.description: Beneath a download after a declined control.

controlSettled.description: Beneath a download after a declined control.

controlFailed.description: Beneath a download after a failed control.

popupOpenServer.description: Popup link to the connected DownloadPulse: the server, or the application on this computer.

optionsNotConnected.message: This browser isn't connected to DownloadPulse. Connect it from the toolbar button.

optionsDisconnect.description: Settings button: disconnect this browser from DownloadPulse.

optionsDisconnectHint.message: Disconnecting removes this browser from your DownloadPulse account. Downloads already sent are kept.

optionsDisconnected.message: Disconnected. DownloadPulse no longer accepts this browser.
optionsDisconnected.description: Settings: after Disconnect, revoked on the server.

optionsDisconnectedLocally.message: Disconnected here, but DownloadPulse couldn't be reached. Disconnect this browser in DownloadPulse under My Account › Connected browsers.
optionsDisconnectedLocally.description: Settings: after Disconnect when the server could not be reached. CRITICAL. 'Disconnect' is DownloadPulse's own button there (DebridPulse key account.browsers.disconnect); 'My Account › Connected browsers' are account.title › account.browsers.title: use that catalog's exact words.

optionsOnPages.description: Settings: section heading for the in-page buttons.

optionsHover.message: Show a download button beside download links

optionsVideo.message: Show a download button on video players
optionsVideo.description: Settings checkbox: the video button (and Firefox's address-bar icon).

optionsOffSites.description: Settings: heading of the list of sites where no buttons are shown.

optionsOffSitesHint.message: On these sites (and their subdomains) no download buttons appear. Right-click still works.

optionsSiteLabel.description: Settings: accessible label of the site field.

optionsAddSite.description: Settings button: add a site to the list.

optionsRemoveSite.description: Settings button: remove a site from the list.

optionsNotifyAttention.message: When a download needs attention in DownloadPulse

popupSettings.description: Popup: the gear button's name and tooltip (opens the extension's settings inside the popup), and the settings view's heading.

popupSiteOn.description: Popup checkbox: show the in-page buttons on the current tab's site.

popupOrServer.message: Or connect to a DownloadPulse server:
popupOrServer.description: Popup, after a failure: label of the server address field, offered so a failing DownloadPulse on this computer never traps the person.

popupFoundLocal.message: DownloadPulse is running on this computer.
popupFoundLocal.description: Popup: a DownloadPulse was found on this computer; the person now chooses it or a different one.

popupConnectThisComputer.message: Connect to DownloadPulse on this computer
popupConnectThisComputer.description: Popup button: connect this browser to the DownloadPulse found on this computer.

popupConnectDifferent.description: Popup button: connect to another DownloadPulse (a server) instead; shows the server address field.

popupChecking.description: Popup: the connection's status while the extension checks whether DownloadPulse answers.

popupUnreachable.description: Popup: the connection's status, in yellow: this browser is connected, but DownloadPulse doesn't answer right now (it may be stopped, or the computer is off its network).

popupConnectionDetails.description: Popup: name and tooltip of the chevron button that shows or hides the server, account and browser.

popupLocalInstance.description: Popup: shown as the server when DownloadPulse is installed on this computer (instead of its local address).

popupBack.description: Popup: name and tooltip of the button that leaves the settings view.

etaShort.description: A download's estimated time remaining, short: TIME is like 1:02:05, 33:12 or 0:45 (hours:minutes:seconds), or ∞ while there is no figure yet. It is an estimate (L27). Keep it short.

listClear.description: Popup footer: name and tooltip of the trash button that removes finished downloads (done, failed, removed) from this list only. DownloadPulse keeps them; active downloads stay.
